signals.title: USD/CAD — Strait of Hormuz Supply Shock
signals.text: WTI crude surged past $104.1/bbl (+2.08%) following Iranian military closure of the Strait of Hormuz, driving aggressive CAD outperformance against USD into the weekly open. Crude terms-of-trade gains clash directly with crowded speculative CAD short positioning (leveraged funds net -96.9k, 8th percentile), accelerating short-squeeze dynamics below the 1.4000 psychological threshold. The resolution of Gulf maritime transit talks in Doha determines whether spot pushes toward the 200-day SMA at 1.3885. Trade bias: Bearish USD/CAD into the open. Catalyst: Sydney/Tokyo market open and Doha mediation headlines on Hormuz transit. Risk: Spot recovery and daily close back above the 20-day SMA at 1.4123.
evidence: Iran's Rezaei: Strait of Hormuz to stay closed until Tehran terms fulfilled
CAD COT leveraged funds net -96,952 (pctl 8, z -1.55)
USD/CAD closed Friday at 1.3973, below 20-day SMA 1.4123

signals.title: NOK/EUR — G10 Bilateral Theme + Strait of Hormuz Energy Spike
signals.text: NOK leads the 1W G10 scorecard at +1.681% (n=2) against EUR laggard at -0.592% (n=9) for a 2.273% spread, heavily amplified by crude supply shocks and Fitch's unscheduled French credit outlook downgrade. Severe energy-driven terms-of-trade divergence favors petroleum-backed NOK while compounding downward pressure on EUR, which sits weighed down by heavily stretched net short leveraged fund positioning (-99.5k, 2nd percentile). The release of German Retail Sales at 07:00 UTC Monday tests EUR downside resilience against sustained petroleum strength. Trade bias: Bullish NOK against EUR (bearish EUR/NOK). Catalyst: Monday European open and German Retail Sales at 07:00 UTC. Risk: Diplomatic reopening of the Strait of Hormuz triggering a rapid pullback in crude benchmarks.
evidence: EUR COT leveraged funds net -99,557 (pctl 2, z -1.78)
Fitch hits France with unscheduled outlook downgrade

signals.title: AUD/USD — RBA Rate Decision + Crowded Long Unwind
signals.text: AUD COT leveraged funds net long sits elevated at +43.9k (67.7% long), exposing AUD/USD to positioning liquidation risks as spot tests 0.7035 ahead of the RBA monetary policy meeting on 3 Nov. While AONIA-SOFR OIS yield spread maintains a +66bp carry advantage in AUD's favor, negative Australian Economic Surprise Index performance (-5.0) limits hawkish follow-through. The RBA interest rate decision at 04:30 UTC on 3 Nov resolves whether the hike bias can be sustained above 0.7000. Trade bias: Neutral AUD/USD with downside skew on hold outcome. Catalyst: RBA interest rate decision on 3 Nov at 04:30 UTC. Risk: RBA delivers an unexpected 25bp rate hike and reiterates hawkish forward guidance.

signals.title: USD/JPY — Safe Haven Squeeze vs Carry Asymmetry
signals.text: Options markets display extreme demand for downside protection with 25-delta risk reversals printing at -2.24 put skew, signaling elevated hedging against USD/JPY declines as geopolitical tensions spike. JPY leveraged fund positioning at -19.2k sits near multi-month highs (94th percentile, z +1.57), which contrasts with a wide +271bp OIS carry advantage supporting USD via SOFR-TONA differentials. The Sydney and Tokyo sessions will determine whether risk-off repatriation triggers a broader liquidation of USD/JPY longs toward the 50-day SMA at 157.41. Trade bias: Bearish USD/JPY on safe-haven flows. Catalyst: Tokyo cash equity and FX open at 00:00 UTC. Risk: US-Iran de-escalation headlines stabilizing global equities and restoring carry appetite.
